sources.title: Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Belt site package

sources.title: Project source registry
sources.usage: Defines formal, background, provisional and prohibited uses.
sources.processing: Used as the controlling source-use boundary.
sources.limitations: Registry does not make unlisted or provisional data official.

sources.title: Agent fact pack

sources.processing: Used only as a navigation layer.

sources.title: Professional standards index and local reference snapshots
sources.usage: Controls mandatory standard IDs, official URLs, local reference paths, hashes, fetch status and access dates used by the standards matrix.
sources.spatial_temporal_coverage: Project-level urban design, detailed planning, land-use classification and architectural depth references.
sources.license_or_citation: Repository citation; underlying official sources retain their own terms.
sources.processing: Read the index and its local reference snapshots without treating repository summaries as new authority.
sources.limitations: MOHURD-ARCH-DESIGN-DEPTH-2016 has missing_source_url and remains a non-mandatory data gap; local snapshots do not replace official promulgated text.

sources.title: Provisional boundaries
sources.usage: Temporary overall design boundary for conceptual generation, validation and visualisation.
sources.processing: Copied without authority upgrade; all derived geometry recalculated in EPSG:4548.
sources.limitations: Not official, precise, statutory, cadastral, engineering or approval geometry.

sources.title: Provisional key-area boundaries
sources.usage: Temporary geometry for the three required key areas.
sources.spatial_temporal_coverage: Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin Community and Dazhongsi rough extents.
sources.processing: Copied without authority upgrade; disclosed in every display layer.
sources.limitations: Not official, precise, statutory, cadastral, engineering, ownership or approval geometry; unsuitable for official redlines or precision scoring. Replace and recalculate every dependent layer, metric and display when official polygons arrive.
